searchText: I do think that this should be considered when setting client defaults though. From my experience most NOs run with almost everything as a default config. Which config have you chosen as the defaults? our defaults are optimizing for network stability rather than MEV: so request a single time with no delay and very short timeout to return the bid the hope is that we can soft-fork and squeeze out the attestation deadline and timing games as much as possible hopefully to 2 seconds before the H fork and presumably we could go as little as 1second attestation deadline soon
